name: Fish net 030

lead: Fish net 030 with a 3-inch (about 7.5 cm) net - for small fish, shrimp and smaller aquariums.

description.html: The 030 is a Resun fish net with a 3-inch net, about 7.5 cm. It has a soft green mesh and a handle with a green loop grip that is easy to hold and hang up. According to the packaging, the mesh is strong and soft, designed to catch fish safely.

The smaller net suits small fish such as guppies, neon tetras and shrimp, as well as nano and small aquariums, where a larger net cannot turn between plants and decor. It is also handy for removing leftover food and leaves from the surface.

description.text: How to catch fish without stress

description.html: It is easiest with two nets: gently guide the fish into one with the other instead of chasing it around the tank. Wet the net before use and move the fish quickly, so it spends as little time out of water as possible. Use a separate net for a quarantine tank, and rinse and dry it after each use.
